title: Conduct rules — Ibarra & Wolfe CPAs
instructions: Evaluate whether each situation at Ibarra & Wolfe CPAs violates the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct.

exhibits.title: Situations
exhibits.content:
1. A member accepts a contingent fee for preparing an original individual income tax return.
2. A member accepts a commission from a software vendor for referring a client the firm only provides tax services to, and discloses it to the client.
3. A member discloses confidential client information in response to a valid court subpoena without client consent.
4. A member keeps a former client's own accounting records until unpaid fees are paid.
5. A member advertises a fixed fee schedule for tax return preparation.
6. A member performing an audit charges a fee contingent on the client obtaining a bank loan.
7. A member shares client information with a peer reviewer.

rows.explanation: Contingent fees for preparing original returns are prohibited.
Commissions are allowed for nonattest clients if disclosed.
Complying with a valid subpoena is an exception to confidentiality.
Client-provided records must be returned even if fees are unpaid.
Advertising that isn't false or misleading is permitted.
Contingent fees are prohibited for attest clients.
Peer review is a permitted disclosure.
